newsitem.title: GERMANY: Germany recalls Tehran ambassador, expels Iranians.
newsitem.headline: Germany recalls Tehran ambassador, expels Iranians.

text.p: Germany said on Thursday that it was recalling its ambassador from Tehran and expelling four Iranian diplomatic staff after a German court accused Iran's leaders of ordering the killings of dissidents in Berlin.
"The participation of Iranian state agencies, as found in the court verdict, represents a flagrant violation of international law," the Foreign Ministry said in a statement.

The court indicated it thought Iran's religious leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei and President Akbar Hashemi Rafsanjani were behind the slaying of a group of Iranian Kurdish leaders in Berlin's Mykonos restaurant in 1992.

Germany, Iran's biggest trading partner and most important friend in the West, had until now doggedly maintained amicable relations while its major allies, above all Britain and the United States, accuse Iran of state terrorism.
Iran has denied all responsibility for the murders and on Thursday the speaker of the Iranian parliament Ali Akbar nateq-Nouri dismissed the court verdict as "political".
